models_evaluated: open-source deep learning prostate cancer detection model on bpMRI

links.outcome: Model AUC on local retrospective bpMRI data against radiologist and histopathology reference standards
links.effect: AUCs of 0.86 (PI-RADS ≥3), 0.91 (PI-RADS ≥4), 0.78 for csPCa; csPCa sensitivity 0.87, specificity 0.53 on 151 patients.
links.quote: The model achieved AUCs of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.80-0.92) and 0.91 (95% CI: 0.85-0.96) for predicting PI-RADS ≥ 3 and ≥ 4 exams, respectively, and 0.78 (95% CI: 0.71-0.86) for csPCa.

unlisted_practices: Sharing model code and weights openly to enable external validation

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation of an open-source deep learning model on biparametric MRI scans from 151 patients to detect prostate cancer, assessing diagnostic accuracy without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
